# Unity female locomotion

Source: Unity Technologies, [Standard Assets Characters](https://github.com/Unity-Technologies/Standard-Assets-Characters).

The four FBX files are unmodified source data from `Assets/_Standard Assets/Characters/Animation/Female/`:

- `Rig/defaultfemale_rig.fbx` → FemaleRig.fbx
- `Animations/Exploration/f@WalkForwards.fbx` → FemaleWalk.fbx
- `Animations/Exploration/f@RunForwards.fbx` → FemaleRun.fbx
- `Animations/Exploration/f@SprintForwards.fbx` → FemaleSprint.fbx

Downloaded 2026-09-11. Fixed source revision and download hashes are recorded in the workspace report `reports/phase8/map4-animation-fix-20260911/`. The publisher's LICENSE.md accompanies these files: Unity Companion License for Unity-dependent projects. These animations are separate from the CC0 VRoid character; they do not inherit the character's license.

Unity retargets the Humanoid animations to the existing Map 4 avatar. Project-specific staff hold and pulse clips live alongside that avatar. No original enemy animations are modified.
